subject: [video] WP05 real acceptance PASSES with avc2: N2TEST WP05 PASS 1041/1041
body: The lead's avc2 core + WP04's inter/me/rc now passes the WP05 end-to-end real test. Command: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh -> last line N2TEST WP05 PASS 1041/1041 (368 stub ASan+UBSan, 368 stub TSan, 305 real). The real part creates a VideoToolbox session 176x144, encodes 10 frames through vt/n2avc_vt.c, converts the AVCC samples to Annex B with the SPS/PPS from CMVideoFormatDescription, runs ffmpeg and requires empty stderr and exactly 10 decoded 176x144 pictures. It also covers 640x480, timing, NotSync/DependsOnOthers, ForceKeyFrame and the format description. run_tests prefes avc2/n2avc_core.c when present and links WP04's three files + kern/n2vk_ref.c/n2vk_dispatch.c. WP03's avc/ core still fails the same test on P-slice CAVLC; it remains gated separately. STATUS.json updated.
